text:
kelly: Quick sync: proposing a temporary pin on runtime 6.1 in ap-northeast-1 due to a tokenizer hash mismatch with embedding models. Observed subtle rerank flips for embed-heavy flows after SDK 6.0.0. Want small controlled window 01:00-01:30 UTC to apply and validate.

sre-bot: (bot) New change window created: pin-window-4890. Use `/deploybot pin` to apply pins.

omar: Can you quantify \"rerank flips\"? Is this user-facing or just eval noise?

kelly: User-facing on a handful of customer tests: top-3 recommendations reorder ~8% of the time with same prompt+seed when SDK >=6.0.0 and runtime 6.1 combined. Logs point at pre-token normalization difference.

riya: Ops suggestion: region-only pin in ap-northeast-1 to runtime=6.0.5 (last known-good) and add a smoke eval comparing embedding hashes.

chen: Also add SDK compatibility note: mark SDK 6.0.0 as \"tokenization-behavior: changed\" for runtime 6.1 until we ship a shim. We'll need a short advisory for enterprise customers.

kelly: Runbook I propose:
1) `/deploybot pin runtime=6.0.5 region=ap-northeast-1 reason=\"tokenizer-hash-diff\" actor=kelly`
2) route 100% of embed model traffic in region to pinned runtime while keeping other region runtimes unchanged
3) run smoke evals: `tools/eval/compare_hashes --suite=embeds --threshold=0.01`
4) if divergence <= 0.01 continue; else revert and open rollback ticket

deploybot: (bot) Command queued: pin-489001. To execute: `/deploybot execute pin-489001`.

omar: Suggest canary first: 5% traffic for 15m, then 25% if green, then 100% after checks. Safer with production embeddings.

kelly: agreed. we'll do 5/25/100 progression and watch both hash divergence and customer metrics (recommendation CTR).

sre-bot: (bot) Canary config created: canary-4890 mapping service=embeddings -> runtime=6.0.5 at 5%.

deploybot: (bot) Executing pin-489001 with canary 5%. Anchor ID anchor-4890-xb. Expires in 24h. Audit audit-4890.

chen: Observability (20m): canary smoke eval divergence 0.003, recommendation CTR stable within noise. No new errors. Proceed to 25%.

riya: Pushing routing r-apn-623 to 25% now. Will monitor p50/p99 and downstream indexing jobs.

omar: Customer comms: I'll draft an advisory noting SDK 6.0.0 tokenization change and recommended pin command: `pip install redwood-sdk==5.9.4` for deterministic results. Include guidance for customers using embeds at scale.

kelly: Engineering follow-ups: we need a runtime shim or a lightweight tokenizer backport in 6.1.1 and an SDK patch that aligns normalization. I'll open PRs and link them in this thread.

sre-bot: (bot) Canary ramp to 25% completed. Monitoring checks green.

deploybot: (bot) Anchor anchor-4890-xb will expire at 2026-03-27T01:00Z unless extended. To extend: `/deploybot anchor extend anchor-4890-xb duration=24h`.

kelly: Leaving anchor for 24h while patches land. If we see any CTR degradation >5% or new customer complaints, revert using `/deploybot pin runtime=6.1 region=ap-northeast-1 reason=\"revert after regression\" actor=<engineer>` and open an incident.

omar: Good call. I'll notify #support-enterprise and attach smoke eval hashes.

chen: Added SDK/runtime flag in the compatibility matrix and updated the release notes stub. Will finalize once PRs are linked.

riya: Thanks team. Will remove anchor early if 6.1.1 ships and smoke evals pass.
